product.name: WaffyApp Escrow Payment Service
product.description: An escrow payment platform that holds buyer funds securely until product or service delivery is confirmed, protecting both buyers and sellers in transactions.

product.name: WaffyApp Broker Escrow Service
product.description: A specialized escrow service for brokers to securely manage client funds and transactions, ensuring protection and transparency for all parties involved.

product.name: WaffyApp Digital Product Sales Support
product.description: A service enabling secure sale and delivery of digital products by withholding access codes or tickets until payment confirmation.

product.description: Integration of multiple secure payment options including credit cards, Apple Pay, bank transfers, and installment plans to facilitate transactions.
